specs_json.compute: High-performance onboard PC; optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin secondary compute

notes: The Unitree H1-2 (2024) is a full-size ~70 kg humanoid with 27 DOF, upgraded from the original H1 with more arm/wrist articulation for manipulation research. Powered by Unitree's high-torque M107 joint motors (up to ~360 N·m), it walks at 3.3 m/s — a humanoid speed record class — on an 864 Wh battery, priced around $119k for research labs.

failure_modes.name: M107 hip motor winding overheating
failure_modes.symptoms: Thermal fault during sustained fast walking, torque derating, controller-forced stop
failure_modes.mitigation: Cap continuous walking speed below thermal limit, monitor winding temps, allow cool-down between locomotion trials

failure_modes.name: Fall damage to head sensor mast
failure_modes.symptoms: Lidar misalignment or failure after fall, perception dropout, cracked head housing
failure_modes.mitigation: Use overhead gantry during controller development, add crash structure, recalibrate extrinsics after any fall

failure_modes.name: Harmonic/planetary reducer backlash growth in wrist joints
failure_modes.symptoms: End-effector positioning error, oscillation during fine manipulation, audible clicking
failure_modes.mitigation: Limit impact loads at end-effector, measure backlash quarterly, replace reducers past tolerance

failure_modes.name: Ankle actuator overload on uneven terrain
failure_modes.symptoms: Balance recovery failures, torque saturation logs, ankle temperature spikes on gravel/slopes
failure_modes.mitigation: Constrain deployment terrain, tune controller torque limits, inspect ankle assemblies after outdoor sessions

failure_modes.name: Power bus brownout under peak multi-joint torque
failure_modes.symptoms: Compute reboot or sensor dropout during jumps/rapid squats, undervoltage log entries
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep battery above 30% for dynamic tests, verify bus capacitance health, update firmware current limits
